verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents concurrency limits, rate limits, or how queued and batch jobs behave. The closest items are a marketing line about "dedicated capacity with guaranteed throughput" and an FAQ note that keys share quota; neither describes concurrency caps or queue semantics. These are adjacent statements, not the documented capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, concurrency limits and queue behavior for batch rendering are documented, so I can plan a production pipeline
